log.note: rotating check 2026-10-01T04:11:52Z, 50 walks run from 230 onward in the rotation: an-editing-session-walk failing. This is a slice, not a sweep: the rest of the set is unchecked.

Triage 2026-10-01, looked at the picture: an-editing-session-walk step 24 (labelsWhole) reads '•..' at 1697,50, and in 2-cut-sc.png that spot is the Properties header's '…' menu button (beside the '?' help button), not a word cut short. So the check is misreading an icon as clipped text; the app is fine there. It first went red in the rotating check right after 39d066d8 (click effects) and passed in the one before it, so that commit nudged the header, but the fix belongs in the walk's label reader: an icon is not a label. first-long-jump-when-zoomed-in-walk missed its 50ms budget by 0.8ms (50.8ms) in the 2026-10-01 sweep and passed in the rotating check before; run it twice before touching anything.

an-editing-session-walk: the WALK's reader was wrong, not the app. Reproduced (forced on a locked screen): step 24 labelsWhole read the Properties header's ••• menu button as '•..' at 1697,50; the real capture shows the ellipsis button drawn whole. Fixed in CutLabelRule.isCut: a reading with no letter or digit is an icon, never a cut label (test dotsWithNoWordsAreAnIconNotACutLabel). Commit 69961eca. After the fix step 24 passes 2 of 2 and the walk runs whole through step 36 (4 real captures).

an-editing-session-walk past step 36 could not be checked: the screen stayed locked all session, the walk is refused unforced (step 8 expectClip), and forced it stops at step 37 because the click on the cut ('Sample Talk join 1') does not open the transition picker under a lock. That is the lock, not the app: a-video-edit-saves-as-a-project-walk and transition-picker-at-a-cut-walk fail the same way forced, both passed in the unlocked 2026-10-01 sweep, and a build of 30eb1232 (before the track reorder) fails the same way forced. expectClip worked under the lock but stays OFF the lock-safe list for that reason: listing it would let these walks reach a cut press that does not fire under a lock and report false failures in locked partial sweeps.

first-long-jump-when-zoomed-in-walk: the walk is RIGHT, the budget is the focus success line. Every jump at 16x on the long talk is 44-54ms in one pass (fails ~1 run in 3). Hand-bisected to f8fe5834 (tiles on Core Animation): b13f03da/5ee0e42c ~160, f8fe5834 onward ~210-240 (sum of 7 timed waits). Not the tiles: CA animation off or no NSView at all changed nothing; a hidden 30fps TimelineView put the old numbers back (155-161). So the old always-running timer split each jump across frames; idle-quiet made it one pass.
